claude.performance_metric: FY2021 net income $2,146M (+~62% YoY); goodwill essentially flat at $20,182M, no divestiture; ~$790M cumulative integration charges
claude.rationale: No product/process incoherence is documented: all four legacy segments were retained intact with essentially unimpaired goodwill and management attributed operating-income growth to "productivity and merger synergies," so p4=0. On the process/organization interface, the DPS Integration Program targeting $600M synergies is documented as producing gains and only being delayed (COVID-attributed) with routine severance charges and a modest $19M workforce-reduction liability — no documented fracture between operations and organization, so p5=0. The slice offers no evidence on the controlling-intent archetype's realized character, hence t1=uncertain. No documented reconciliation failure of value-capture logics; synergies were realized, so t2=0.

grok.performance_metric: FY2021 net income $2,146M (+62% YoY); no divestiture, goodwill unimpaired
grok.rationale: The slice documents no product/process interface disruption: all four reportable segments (including Coffee Systems and the DPSG-legacy beverage segments) remained intact through FY2021 with essentially flat, unimpaired segment goodwill totaling $20,182 million and rising segment net sales. On the process/organization interface, the DPS Integration Program incurred cumulative pre-tax charges of ~$790 million (mainly professional fees and severance) and ran past its original 2021 target into 2022 due to COVID-19 delays, but management expressly attributed 2021 segment operating-income growth to realized productivity and merger synergies, so no fracture is documented.
